title: Ellen Carr & Katrina Dudley Book Talk
summary: The speakers discuss their book's inspiration, which stems from observing a lack of women in investment management despite the field offering flexible hours and not requiring the extreme dedication of corporate law or surgery. They argue that investing is a highly analytical yet creative profession that relies on pattern recognition and critical thinking rather than the strong math skills often misperceived as necessary, noting that most roles do not require more than sixth-grade algebra.
